headline: Dead Lands Battles Rage As Neighboring Fronts Settle Into Attrition
war_summary: Combat across the central front has narrowed over the past three hours, leaving the Dead Lands as the primary flashpoint for concrete territorial exchanges. Intense fighting around Liberation Point and Sun's Hollow produced three base transitions in the last two hours alone, driven by nearly two thousand combined casualties and a surging enlistment rate. By contrast, the recent flare-ups in Drowned Vale and Stema Landing have abruptly cooled, with base shifts halting entirely and Drowned Vale reporting a complete lull in casualties as Colonial forces secure the sector. Elsewhere, positional warfare without immediate base flips dominates the map. Fierce, accelerating casualty exchanges continue along the trenches of Weathered Expanse, where over nine hundred troops fell in two hours, alongside heavy skirmishing in Farranac Coast, Loch Mor, and Endless Shore. While frontline movement has temporarily frozen across these peripheral sectors, the steady buildup of reinforcements suggests severe pressure remains along the entire dividing line.
